description: Flying Cement Company Limited, formerly Zaman Cement Company Limited, was incorporated in December 1992 as a public limited company. Its factory at Mangowal in District Khushab, in the heart of Punjab, stands on more than 121 acres and comprises a single kiln with an installed capacity of 2,000 tonnes per day, or 600,000 tonnes of cement a year, using dry-process technology. The plant was supplied by IHI of Japan, which the company says redesigned and re-engineered it, and IHI acts as its supplier and technical advisor.
sourceNote: Written from: https://flyingcement.com/page/profile-of-the-company.html (former name, incorporation, plant location and land, single kiln capacity, IHI supply and re-engineering) and https://flyingcement.com/page/profile-of-the-company/contact.html (registered and head office address, telephone) (accessed 2026-10-17). No chief executive is named on the pages read, so ceo is null.
